stations.title: Odette
stations.say: Can we send the fete slips in?

stations.title: Studio laptop
stations.text: Sends JSON, which these forms do not read.

stations.title: Cupboard server
stations.text: Takes forms only as the website sends them.

captions: Odette has paper request slips and jingle entries from the village fete to send in.
The laptop sends JSON, but the server takes these only as the website's forms send them.
You write a form body, send it, and send a file in a body made of parts, in three tasks.
Nia's jingle script arrives as a file, and her entry is in the competition.
A form sends names and values, or parts when there is a file. The content-type says which.
